title: Riverside Books catalog record
description: One shared book catalog record consumed by Product D for marketing content generation.

book_id.description: Stable, non-empty identifier for the book.

author.description: Primary author name for customer-facing content.

genre.description: Human-readable genre label used for positioning and discovery.

price.description: Non-negative retail price in USD, represented in decimal dollars with no more than two decimal places.

stock_status.description: Canonical availability label that may affect marketing language; Product D does not manage inventory.

description.description: Approved book description used as the primary grounding source for generated copy.

rating.description: Average customer rating on an inclusive 0.0 to 5.0 scale. The field is numeric and may use fractional precision; no rating should be invented when the value is unavailable.

promotional_tag.description: One optional promotional label for the book, or null when no approved label applies. This field is intentionally not an array.
